name: Ariden's Camp
summary: Ariden's Camp is an abandoned encampment nestled just north of the path threading through Deadwind Pass. Left decaying in the shadow of Karazhan, it stands as an eerie, quiet anomaly amidst the desolate canyon winds. Travelers between Duskwood and the Swamp of Sorrows often pass it with unease, wondering who once pitched a tent here.

sections.title: A Silent Encampment
sections.body: Tucked against the crags north of the gorge road connecting Duskwood to the Swamp of Sorrows, this dilapidated campsite looks like an ordinary transient stop long forsaken by living men. Yet in the oppressive gloom of Deadwind Pass, nothing remains unmarred by dark sorcery. Whoever named the camp Ariden's and whatever fortune its owner sought in Karazhan's orbit, the pass's lingering horrors swallowed it, leaving only weathered cloth, cold ashes, and an enduring mystery.

faq.answer: Ariden's Camp is located in Deadwind Pass, situated just north of the main road that links Duskwood in the west to the Swamp of Sorrows in the east, not far from Karazhan.

faq.q: Are there any active threats at the camp right now?
faq.answer: The immediate clearing of the camp is quiet and eerily still, though Deadwind Pass itself is prowled by deadly deadwind ogres, spectral apparitions, and the foul winged beasts that roost near Karazhan.

angles.text: For scholars of the arcane, the deserted camp is an unsettling reminder of how close Karazhan looms; few who linger near Medivh's tower stay long.
Someone set up camp beneath the most terrifying spire in the Eastern Kingdoms and never came back for their things. Either extraordinarily ambitious or remarkably foolish.
